readings: For each event (`budget.link_to_event`), show the average `spent` and the average `remaining` across its budget lines, ignoring NULLs. Also show its average remaining minus the overall average remaining, where the overall average is the average of `remaining` across all individual budget lines (every non-NULL `remaining` value counts once). List the 10 events with the largest difference, highest first, with NULL differences last. Don't round.

For each event (`budget.link_to_event`), show the average `spent` and the average `remaining` across its budget lines, ignoring NULLs. Also show its average remaining minus the overall average remaining, where the overall average is the mean of the per-event average remaining values (each event counts once, regardless of how many budget lines it has). List the 10 events with the largest difference, highest first, with NULL differences last. Don't round.
queries:
SELECT link_to_event,
       AVG(spent) AS avg_spent,
       AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining,
       AVG(remaining) - (SELECT AVG(remaining) FROM budget) AS diff
FROM budget
GROUP BY link_to_event
ORDER BY diff IS NULL, diff DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH per_event AS (
    SELECT link_to_event,
           AVG(spent) AS avg_spent,
           AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
)
SELECT link_to_event,
       avg_spent,
       avg_remaining,
       avg_remaining - (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM per_event) AS diff
FROM per_event
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10;
